title: Bake & Mystery Challenge

blocks.title: Safety first
blocks.text: Check your school’s food requirements and every student’s allergies and dietary needs against each ingredient label, including any Mystery ingredient. Only adults handle the oven and hot pans.

items: Book the oven and an adult; check the oven holds every team’s pan at once
Shop from the recipe card: one recipe per team makes about 12–18 standard cupcakes
Each team: its own labelled cupcake pan with liners, bowl, square pan, measuring tools and fork
Hand-washing and cleaning supplies, oven mitts, and a safe spot for hot pans
Confirm whether students may eat what they bake; it won’t be cool by the end of the lesson

blocks.text: Choose one Mystery twist (if running Mystery)

items.text: Teams fold in one ingredient, such as chocolate chips; allergy-check it first.
Remove one measuring cup; teams measure with what’s left.
Halfway through mixing, every student swaps to a new role.

items.title: Preheat
items.text: An adult switches the oven to 350°F (175°C) as the lesson begins, so it is hot when the pans are ready.

items.title: Cutoff and roles
items.text: Announce the pans-in time, 25–30 min from now. Teams wash hands and pick roles: Leader, Reader, Ingredient Manager, Mixer, Timekeeper, Clean-Up Crew; smaller teams double up.

items.title: Reveal the twist (Mystery only)
items.text: Tell teams the twist you chose.

items.title: Mix
items.text: Teams follow the recipe. Circulate: by halfway, every team’s dry ingredients are mixed.

items.title: Pans in
items.text: All pans go in together at the cutoff; they bake 20–25 min during clean-up and reflection.
